cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically, and none gives a figure for revenue paid electronically. GRA's Ghana.gov and ITAPS payment facts date from 2021 and 2019.
cells.note: From 1 November 2026 traffic fines notified under TraffiTech-GH can be paid by mobile money or card (GHA-004), so some fees are paid electronically. Nothing in the window says the main taxes and customs duties are, so not stage 4.
